subject: SOC 2 Type II, finding follow-up and bridge letter request - FinBank
messages:
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finbank.com, Karen Liu <karen.liu@finbank.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + clarification on finding #4 / bridge letter request

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week. As part of our vendor review we need the SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period Jan 1, 2025 - Jun 30, 2025. In particular, our security assessment flagged Finding #4 (logical access controls) and noted the auditor exception for a monitoring gap between 2025-05-15 and 2025-05-28.

Can you please:
- Share the signed SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and the auditor's management response summary for the finding.
- Confirm the remediation status and provide evidence (ticket IDs, test logs, screenshots) that show the issue was resolved and validated.
- Provide a bridge letter addressing the May 15-28 gap (we will need to present the bridge letter to internal audit).

Do you expect to provide these items by the end of next week? Procurement also asked whether the bridge letter needs to be on company letterhead and signed.

Appreciate a point of contact and ETA.

Best,
Ethan
Security Risk Manager
FinBank
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + clarification on finding #4 / bridge letter request

Hi Ethan,

Thanks — we can provide everything you requested. I am looping in Monica (Customer Security) and Jonas (Compliance) who are leading the remediation and evidence collection. Initial plan below:

- SOC 2 Type II signed report (Jan 1 - Jun 30, 2025) — we will attach the PDF.
- Management response summary for Finding #4 — attached as a PDF.
- Remediation evidence export (tickets + validation logs) — we will provide a consolidated ZIP.
- Draft bridge letter on Redwood letterhead — we will send a DOCX for review and then produce a signed PDF.

Proposed ETA: draft materials by Thu, Oct 16 and final signed artifacts by Mon, Oct 20, assuming no major changes from your auditors. Can you confirm whether your audit team needs the bridge letter notarized or simply signed by an officer?

I'll coordinate a quick 20-minute call if you'd like a walkthrough of the evidence.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + clarification on finding #4 / bridge letter request

Ethan,

Quick technical addendum from Compliance: Finding #4 related to a misconfigured role mapping that allowed elevated read access for a small set of service accounts. The change in May was due to a rollout script that missed a conditional check.

What we did:
- Created remediation ticket SUP-7894 (Jira) on 2025-05-29.
- Rolled back the offending change and deployed a fix on 2025-06-02.
- Performed validation scans and access reviews on 2025-06-08 and 2025-10-12.

All remediation testing artifacts and logs are included in the evidence export (see attached ZIP). The compliance team validated the fix and recorded test cases in the tracker. If you need specific logs, we can extract the relevant chunks and timestamped screenshots.

Reference: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUP-7894

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Compliance & Controls
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge letter draft and next steps

Hi Ethan,

Attached is a draft bridge letter on Redwood letterhead (bridge_letter_finbank_draft.docx). A few notes:
- The draft explains the monitoring gap (2025-05-15 through 2025-05-28) and summarizes remediation actions and validation dates.
- We included an officer signature block. If FinBank requires a company officer to sign in front of a notary, please advise and we'll schedule.
- We plan to circulate the bridge letter for signature via DocuSign. I will create the envelope once you confirm the final wording.

Also attaching: management_response_summary.pdf and remediation_tracker.csv for quick reference.

If your team prefers, we can set a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to walk through the evidence before signing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Security Manager
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karen Liu <karen.liu@finbank.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge letter draft and next steps

Monica, Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple quick items:
- FinBank requires a signed bridge letter on company letterhead. Notarization is not required — just an officer signature is fine.
- Procurement is asking for the DocuSign link and the CP (vendor) ID so they can tie the document to the PO. Our procurement record is FINBANK-9981.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide any SLA credit or goodwill for the monitoring gap period? That is a separate conversation but procurement flagged it.

If you can send the DocuSign link and the signed PDF by Mon, Oct 20 that would keep us on schedule.

Best,
Ethan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge letter draft and next steps — DocuSign and final artifacts

Hi Ethan,

Thanks — attached is the signed SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_TypeII_2025-01-01_06-30_redwood_signed.pdf) and the signed bridge letter (bridge_letter_finbank_signed.pdf). For signing we used the following DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123-finbank-bridge.

A couple clarifications:
- Jonas confirmed remediation was implemented and validated (see SUP-7894). Evidence files were exported and are available in the ZIP we attached earlier. If you need a filtered subset for audit submission, tell us which timestamps and we'll extract them.
- Regarding SLA credit: Marissa (cc'd, Legal) will review the procurement request and will follow up separately on any commercial concessions.

If you'd like a 15-minute wrap-up call to confirm everything for your audit packet, I'm available Wed afternoon PST.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
